description: Soft, calm hospitality bedroom development with clean bedding whites, open shadows, warm natural materials, and gentle contrast.

exposure.instruction: Increase exposure enough for soft, welcoming natural light while preserving bedding and window highlight detail.

shadows.instruction: Open dark room areas enough to reveal existing detail while preserving calm natural depth.

highlights.instruction: Recover window and pale-textile highlights while keeping bedding whites clean and naturally textured.

contrast.instruction: Establish gentle, clean tonal separation for a calm hospitality mood without flattening the room.

whiteBalance.instruction: Keep light warmly natural without orange or yellow casts; maintain clean, neutral bedding whites.

vibrance.instruction: Enrich muted existing room color gently while preserving natural textiles and wood.

saturation.instruction: Keep saturation conservative and textiles neutral.

texture.instruction: Reveal bedding and fabric texture softly without harsh detail or artificial crispness.

clarity.instruction: Use low-to-moderate clarity to retain softness.

materialPriorities.instruction: Keep bedding and textiles neutral, soft and faithful to the original.
Retain natural warm wood without orange saturation.
